This is happening because the test uses `ExpectNoEvent`, without `expectedPath` parameter, which makes a `new string[] { null }` on line 239. 
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/1a296c06fff8750b4658f6f7d901347e006744d0/src/libraries/System.IO.FileSystem.Watcher/tests/Utility/FileSystemWatcherTest.cs#L237-L239

review_comments:
so far, the `VerifyExpectedPaths` was using `Path.GetFullPath(e.FullPath)`, should we keep doing that?

```suggestion
                if (expectedPaths == null || expectedPaths.Contains(Path.GetFullPath(e.FullPath)))
```
We changed FileSystemEventArgs.FullPath this release to actually return the full path https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/62606, so we shouldn't need GetFullPath anymore.
